name: Oboreta Saki no Ori no Naka
source:
The man who appears before Koki is Ryo,
who says he wants to make Koki into his pet.
In desperation, Koki agrees and begins his life as a pet.
Just as he is getting used to this life, his former best friend Asakura appears.
Asakura wants to return Koki to his former life, but Koki may be too far gone...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE256266.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
出现在Koki面前的男人是Ryo，
谁说他想让Koki成为他的宠物。
无奈之下，Koki同意了并开始了他的宠物生活。
正当他习惯这种生活时，他以前最好的朋友朝仓出现了。
朝仓想让Koki回到以前的生活，但Koki可能已经走得太远了……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE256266.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
